chunks: Everything in this book that is from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Yaḥyā al-Madāʾinī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ẓarīf ibn Nāṣiḥ, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Yaḥyā al-Madāʾinī.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: A well-known transmitter in the chain, identified by his nisbah.
key_terms.الْمَدَائِنِيِّ: A nisbah identifying the narrator as being from al-Madāʾin.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct citation of the sanad by the compiler.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Yaḥyā al-Madāʾinī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a transmission-chain clarification from Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the sanad through which al-Ṣadūq transmits reports from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Yaḥyā al-Madāʾinī. Its significance lies in hadith documentation and source-tracing rather than legal or theological teaching.
